dct_description_sm:
There are some County roads that restrict axle loading to a maximum of 5 tonnes per axle to protect them from damage. 
Schedule "K" - designated seasonal load limited Highways, during the Load Restriction period including, but not restricted to, the period from March 1 to April 30 of each year.
Schedule "L" - designated load limited Highways all year round.
